Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other
vehicle was changing lanes. Presenting complaints included headache, dizziness, light
sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, which are consistent with the mechanism and
force of the impact. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm a
concussion. No prior injury to the head or neck is known from the patient's history or
available records. The patient completed 23 visits consisting of symptom monitoring,
vestibular and cognitive therapy, and graduated exertion guidance. Care followed a
typical course for this injury, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms resolved
and functional capacity returned. Billed services correspond to the treatment
documented in the chart, with no repeated charges identified. The patient is now
released to full activity, with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
